name: @finapp/m26-legal-ai
description: M26 — Legal AI (Stage 5, GOVERNED, mvp:false): AI assistance for the legal domain — matter/case summaries, chronology, issue/obligation/deadline extraction, clause analysis, evidence-gap detection and drafting assistance — every output a human-reviewed, citation-backed SUGGESTION. LEGAL-ADVISORY ONLY: it never files, never reaches a legal conclusion, never settles or enforces, never mutates a matter, and never exposes privileged/work-product data to unauthorized users (privilege + ethical-wall boundaries; CLAUDE.md hard rules). It reuses the M24 governed AI gateway/registries + request->output->human-review pipeline BY CONTRACT (no second AI engine, no provider/routing/DLP), references M14 legal matters + M09 documents by OPAQUE id (reads no m14/m09 table; M14 stays the legal source of truth), audits every action under the shared AI_ prefix (AI_LEGAL_*), shares the m24 ai.* permission namespace, and owns NO second outbox and NO new event family (M24 emits the ai.*_lifecycle events). No production provider, no network, no HTTP client, no SDK.
